question: I finished closing the kitchen, but the dishwasher is still running. What should I mark on the board and what should I do with the dishwasher?
expected_behavior: Mark the existing Kitchen Close card complete. Clip the Running tag to the dishwasher handle and leave unloading until the next morning. Do not create another closing card.
required_facts: Complete the existing Kitchen Close card
Clip the Running tag to the handle
Leave unloading for the next morning

question: The store ran out of an item on our shared grocery list and nobody approved a replacement. What should I record?
expected_behavior: Leave the original item unchecked and add the note Out of stock. Keep it available for the next shopper to retry.
required_facts: Add the note Out of stock

question: I need the shared cordless drill this afternoon. Where do I find it, what do I log, and where does the kit go when I finish?
expected_behavior: Find it in the blue tool bin in the hallway cupboard. Put your name, tool name and expected return time on the Tool Checkout card. Return the drill and bits to that bin and close your checkout entry.
required_facts: Blue tool bin in the hallway cupboard
Tool Checkout card with name, tool and expected return time
Return the drill and bits to the bin

question: The bathroom tap has a slow drip even with the handle shut. How do I report it to our household?
expected_behavior: Check for an existing card for that fixture. Add the observation there or open a Plumbing card on the Maintenance board. Record the room, when you noticed the drip, and whether it continues with the handle closed. Notify the maintenance coordinator through the card. A photo is optional if safe to take.
required_facts: Use a Plumbing card on the Maintenance board
Reuse an existing fixture card if present
Record room, time first noticed and whether it drips with handle closed
Notify the maintenance coordinator through the card

question: A friend is staying overnight. What needs to be in place before I mark their room ready?
expected_behavior: Set out one clean sheet set, two clean towels on the bench at the foot of the bed, and a filled water carafe on the bedside table. Check that the bedside lamp works. Complete the Guest Room Ready card after the checks, or leave it open and note what is missing.
required_facts: Two clean towels on the bench at the foot of the bed
Filled water carafe on the bedside table
Complete Guest Room Ready only after the items and check are done
